prompt_md: Every day you drive 30 km at a constant speed picked uniformly at random between 30 and 90 km/h. On average, how many minutes does the drive take?
prompt_short: 30 km at a random speed from 30 to 90 km/h. Average minutes?
hint_md: Average the time, not the speed.
explain_intuition_md: The average speed is 60 km/h, which would make it 30 minutes. But slow days cost more extra time than fast days save: at 30 km/h the drive takes 60 minutes, at 90 km/h only 20. Averaging the times instead of the speeds gives about 33 minutes.
